skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK to a single target. After casting the first Ultimate, can reduce [No Crit No Death].

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Reduces the target's [No Crit No Death] by 1 turn.Deals 7000% ATK of Direct DMG to a single target (only affected by high-level DMG Free), negates 45% [Specialized Evade] and [Non-Crit DMG Free], and pierces [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Increase Crit Rate by 50%Ultimate ATK DMG 7000% → 10,000%

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). After taking an action, self and surrounding allies trigger [Evolve] on the target. Before each round, restores HP to all allies equal to 300% of Max HP, lasting 2 rounds. Permanently gains +50% [Non-Crit DMG Free].[Evolve]: immediately cancels the target's [Unyielding] and [Ignore DMG] statuses.[Non-Crit DMG Free]: effective against all DMG types; cannot co-exist with [Agility].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). After all allies take an action, trigger [Evolve] on the target. Before each round, restores HP to all allies equal to 350% of Max HP, lasting 2 rounds. Permanently gains +55% [Non-Crit DMG Free].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by (+20). After all allies take an action, trigger [Evolve] on the target. Before each round, restores HP to all allies equal to 350% of Max HP, lasting 3 rounds. Permanently gains +60% [Non-Crit DMG Free].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: (Basic Core Effect) (1 Grappler, 2 Esper): Grants 3 energy per round. In the first 3 rounds, allies gain 30% Combat DMG increase.(Advance Core Effect) (1 Grappler, 1 Duelist, 2 Esper): When battle begins, grants allies permanent [Excess Recovery] (excess HP healing is converted to [HP Shield] to offset DMG received, cannot exceed 20x Max HP). All allies gain 30% Combat immunity. When battle begins, front-row allies are healed by 80% of their Max HP, lasting 3 rounds.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: (Basic & Advanced Core): Combat DMG increase 30% > 50%. When allies perform a follow-up, gain another 1 energy (1x per round).

skills.name: Awaken 3 Passive
skills.desc: (Basic & Advanced Core): Combat DMG increase 30% > 50%. When allies perform a follow-up, gain another 1 energy (2x per round).

effects.desc: PvP (advanced) tier of Resilience — shield ignores stronger damage, only penetrated by advanced breakers.
Shield ignores damage from certain attacks. Must be penetrated by Breakthrough or Charge/True DMG.
Survival buff that, when present, prevents the unit from being crited and cannot die, retaining 70% of its health for the duration of the effect.
Reduces all non-critical damage (usually to 1). Cannot survive and avoid Agility.
Cumulative explosive classes that each (up to a limit) add one target to the Ultimate skill.
